messages.text:
Hey,

I haven't recieved any updates on the 7 b30 units I have ordered.

Any idea what's going on? Thought these were already shipping.

Thanks
Robert A.

Hi Robert,

Thanks for checking in, and sorry you have been left waiting on these.

Here is where your seven B30 units stand. Six of them, three on Shop···· and three on Shop····, are in the first batch. Those units have been built and tested and are on their way to our Chattanooga warehouse right now, and they go out to you as soon as that shipment is checked in. The date on those two orders was October 15, so we are past it, and that is on us. You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The seventh unit, on Shop····, sits in a later batch and ships November 7. The free Power K. on each order goes in the same box as the miner, as does the Miner D. on the two July orders.

One thing worth doing: we wrote to you on September 15 by email and by text with the new batch dates and the reason for the change, and our messages have been landing in junk for some customers. Adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts will make sure the tracking mail reaches you. Your price stays locked as it is.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
